measurements.template: Apliiq v5 designer, independent heavyweight pullover hoodie (ind4000), transfer print, read 2026-10-14 from Apliiq's own garment images: front view 6399 at 24 px/in, back 4559, left sleeve 5947 and right sleeve 4577 at 20 px/in (scales read from Apliiq's inch readouts). The template garment reads about size L/XL.
measurements.front area: 13.50 x 10.00 in (324 x 240 px), top 3.6 in below the CF hood seam (seam read at y 164; the 2026-09-24 Core Hoodie reading was y 170, 3.3 in)
measurements.left sleeve area: 3.50 x 19.00 in (70 x 380 px); bottom edge 3.75 in above the cuff seam
measurements.front_hood_seam_to_pocket_top_S: 16.0 in on the template (pocket top y 549). Pass: Big Stack needs 12.45 in. Canvas clearance under the stack is 5.0 in.
measurements.sleeve width check: the sleeve area is 3.50 in wide along its whole length, including the GA position. Pass.
measurements.classic_navy_exact_name: navy (Apliiq swatch name; designs are named '· Navy')
measurements.supplier constraint: Apliiq keeps art inside its areas. Front art sits at the top of the front area (about 3.6 in below the CF hood seam on the template) and the sleeve GA on the bottom of the sleeve area (3.75 in above the cuff seam); each production note carries the handoff figure (3.00 in). The back area starts below the hood, which is why the owner dropped back prints.
